scope: One deterministic 100-pole partial finite face per analytic family; same finite faces and query/operand geometry before and after conversion. Projection:25 fixed points. Section:finite plane through known interior point. Common:same clipping box. Timings exclude result checking. Pair order alternates. Inputs, operands and first measured Section/Common results are preserved as BRep files outside timed work. 33 edge samples and 25 interior face samples per result compare geometry bidirectionally; Boolean area allowance is tolerance*(1+both boundary lengths). Results are sampled correctness checks, not global operation-result certificates. Medians exclude warmup; this workload is not a universal 50% guarantee.

results.message: valid measurements; median reduction meets 50% target
